draft.emotion: simple and satisfying, like reaching for a snack you enjoy
notes: Usually an uncountable noun when speaking in general ('Compré queso'), though it can be countable when referring to whole wheels or types of cheese.
In Mexico, 'quesillo' (or 'queso Oaxaca') is a very popular stringy white cheese, whereas 'queso' is the general term.
